propositions: The production LLM-Review gate must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles to dogfood the client path and surface provider-specific failures before affecting users
The review-bot container image requires --extra bedrock in its uv sync command to install pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock module, without which the first Bedrock call fails with LLMConfigError

Three environment variables (frontier/standard/trivial model slots) must be set in docker-compose.yml to point class-based model resolution to Bedrock inference profiles, preserving the per-pass model split (opus for Pass-1, sonnet for Pass-2/Pass-4)

A native CloudWatch alarm dimensioned by ModelId on AWS/Bedrock InvocationClientErrors must be deployed and proven operational (state != INSUFFICIENT_DATA with real datapoints) before the cutover takes effect

The kill switch (reverting the three env vars) must be proven to restore Anthropic-path voting with working credentials before the flip is submitted, and a denied-access drill must confirm the gate fails closed on provider outages
